name: 奧瑞恩男性偏武 · 弦樂器
prompt: Production 2D hand-painted fantasy RPG animation sprite atlas. SQUARE RGB OPAQUE PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no alpha. EXACT 6 columns by 6 rows, thirty-six SEPARATE full-body miniature sprites. Same person, costume, weapon, scale and right-facing three-quarter view every frame. Each sprite no more than 65% cell width, generous 35px magenta gutters, NO touching neighbouring poses. No text, no grid lines, no scenery or floor. Adult anatomy, fine painterly details at 150px character height, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. SUBJECT: athletic adult European-looking man with short chestnut hair, polished blue-grey plate shoulders and cuirass, cream and royal blue surcoat with gold sun trim, brown gauntlets and armoured boots. Held equipment MUST be: a small wooden lute held across torso, one hand fretting and other strumming. SIX ROWS, each six frames: ROW1 idle breathing loop; ROW2 attack: ready, anticipation, windup, strong contact/release, follow-through, recovery. Bring lute into playing position, fingers strum rhythmically, small compact golden musical sparks, then settle. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: athletic adult European-looking man with short chestnut hair, polished blue-grey plate shoulders and cuirass, cream and royal blue surcoat with gold sun trim, brown gauntlets and armoured boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency. 6 columns, 6 rows, 36 poses.
